title: TURKEY GIBLETS A LA BOURGEOISE
instructions: --The giblets of turkey consist of the pinions,  feet,  neck and gizzard. After having scalded pick them well and put in a saucepan with a piece of butter, some parsley,  green onions, clove of garlic, sprig of thyme,  bay-leaf, a spoonful of flour moistened with stock,  salt and pepper. Brown to a good color.
